}}{{Quote|Please note that GSI is not responsible for the actions of any underground creatures disturbed by the Seeker Droid's activities|From the "Handy guide to GSI's industrial-grade Seeker Droid"|<ref name="mail">{{TORcite|type=message|"Seeker Droid Instructions"|GSI}}</ref>}}
The '''Subterranean Seeker Droid''' was a specialized excavation droid designed by [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] by the time of the [[Galactic War]], to dig underneath the surface and extract objects buried there. Originally created for the extraction of subsurface detonate mines,<ref name="mail" /> it evolved into a versatile tool for treasure hunting and excavating, capable of carefully extracting an object from under ground without damaging it; or provide a scan of the nearby area in search of prospective locations for excavating.<ref name="Seeker Droid">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=item|Seeker Droid|Seeker Droid Missions}}</ref>

Several similar excavation droid models manufactured by other companies existed.<ref name="Excavation droid">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=other|"Excavation" and "Salvage" droids from [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] salvage missions}}</ref>

During the [[Seeds of Rage|hunt for Seeds of Rage]], both [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republican]] agents used GSI Seeker Droids to unearth the Seeds of Rage from various sites across the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]].<ref name="rage">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=other|"Weapons of Chaos/Buried Evils" quest line}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Subterranean seeker droids were introduced with the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'' expansion]] for the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' video game. The seeker droids are used during a level 55 chain of side quests involving the [[Seeds of Rage]] and can also be used to seek other treasures buried on various planets of the game.
